newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Montebello, Calif..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Montebello, Calif..

text.p: NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN, pursuant to section 53692 of the California Government Code, that the City of Montebello, California (the City''), intends to sell, at public sale, $4,500,000 1997 Tax and Revenue Anticipation Notes. Bids will be received 10:00 a.m., Pacific time, on

and, without further advertising, so long as a proposal has not theretofore been accepted by the City, on any Monday thereafter, at the offices of Seidler-Fitzgerald Public Finance, 515 South Figueroa Street, Suite 1100, Los
Angeles, California 90017, and the sale will be awarded by the City Administrator or his designee, pursuant to
authority delegated by the City Council, within 26 hours after the expiration of the time prescribed for the receipt of bids.
